reporting-org.narrative: United Nations Office for Project Services

description.narrative:
UNOPS provides support services to United Nations Development Cooperation Office. The UN development system, through reforms and the leadership of Resident Coordinators, is positioned to support countries in achieving the SDGs by driving policy shifts, developing bankable projects, attracting diverse financing, and building capacities. DCO sits at the heart of the Resident Coordinator System providing global solutions and ensuring its smooth functioning. Effective implementation of these solutions demands, among others, improved use of science, technology, and innovation, better data and strengthened governance.

UNOPS runs simultaneously two projects to support DCO in delivery of its mandate: Data and Digital Transformation and UNSDG Business Innovation Group Support (BIG). Data and Digital Transformation Project delivers changes to the ways of working at all levels of the Resident Coordinator System. This includes the ways in which data is collected, processed and used. The project will also digitize a number of administrative task and introduce
automated workflows for the largest volume / most repetitive business processes.
